John Phelan had zero Naval experience or military experience of any kind. He was a businessman and donor to the Trump campaign, who bizarrely got tapped to be Sec of Navy. 

Now, 2 months into a war where the U.S. Navy enforces a high-stakes blockade of Iranian ports near the Strait of Hormuz, he is suddenly removed with zero explanation.

The appointment was bad. The timing of this was worse. This is inexcusable stuff.


Sean Parnell (@SeanParnellASW)

STATEMENT: 

Secretary of the Navy John C.

To recap: Trump started a massive mid-cycle redistricting war in Texas. Democrats responded by gerrymandering everywhere they could, and got Ds to turn out for a voter referendum that will cost Rs four seats. Trump responds by claiming (of course) the election was stolen.

Just following up here: Republicans have now begun the process to pass a filibuster-proof, $70b bill to fund immigration enforcement for the rest of Trump's term. Ds had several chances to stop it, but, as I said, rolled over.




Isaac Saul (@Ike_Saul)

Democrats absolutely roll over again. Literal clockwork. Trump and Rs can always bank on it





— https://nitter.net/Ike_Saul/status/2039447779915776081#m

Trump, who set off an off-cycle, nationwide gerrymandering war that spread to Virginia, called into a Virginia radio station last night to say that gerrymandering is "not good" and Virginia voters should vote against it.

The cost of war is genuinely astounding. 

- First week of Iran war cost $11.3 billion
- Trump seeking a $1.5 *trillion* Pentagon budget
- Gas prices remain above $4
- Iran demanding billions in war reparations
- UAE now asking the U.S. for a "financial lifeline"

I think the term "ceasefire" might be most overused word of the last four or five years


Disclose.tv (@disclosetv)

JUST IN - Iran's military spokesperson says: "Iran will soon respond to and retaliate against this armed piracy by the U.S. Army." — Tasnim



— https://nitter.net/disclosetv/status/2045985332466680058#m
Someone is putting these all over gas stations in the Philly area
